promptReference.text: Repaint this exact Champions of Krynn DOS combat sprite in place. Reference 1 is the original 96×96 icon enlarged 8× with nearest-neighbor, so each of its original 24×24 logical pixels is a clear 32×32 square. Reference 2 is the exact binary occupancy mask at the same coordinates and canvas: white means the source cell is occupied and black means transparent. The original sprite geometry is locked: preserve every occupied and transparent cell, all pose and object locations, limb connections, weapon shapes, and the full outer silhouette. Do not move, resize, crop, rotate, add, remove, or split any part. Repaint/colorize only the existing sprite, with crisp high-contrast fantasy pixel art, rich cyan and teal armor with layered highlights and shadow, vivid but restrained red accents, dark outlines, metallic gray and bright white on the existing held implements. Keep the source's exact small character identity and details. Place no paint outside the white mask. Black outside the character, no glow, no text, no backdrop, no frame, no extra objects. Keep the reference canvas and composition exactly.

The original sprite geometry is locked: preserve every occupied and transparent cell, all pose and object locations, limb connections, sword and shield shapes, and the full outer silhouette. Do not move, resize, crop, rotate, add, remove, or split any part. Keep the exact source head, arms, hands, stance, sword angle, shield location and connections. Place no paint outside the white mask. Black outside the character, no glow, no text, no backdrop, no frame, no extra objects. Keep the reference canvas and composition exactly.
